डीन p. p. [डी-क्त] Flown up.
--नं
The flight of a bird. The varieties
of the flight of birds are said to be
101, the word prefixed to डीन
showing the particular mode of flight;
e. g. अवडीनं, उड्डीनं, प्रडीनं, अभिडीनं,
विडीनं, परिडीनं, पराडीनं &c.
